accepted.statement: The system shall allow an employee to submit a leave request specifying leave type.
quotes: The system shall allow an employee to submit a leave request specifying leave type, start date, and end date.

accepted.statement: The system shall allow an employee to submit a leave request specifying a start date.
quotes: The system shall allow an employee to submit a leave request specifying leave type, start date, and end date.

accepted.statement: The system shall allow an employee to submit a leave request specifying an end date.
quotes: The system shall allow an employee to submit a leave request specifying leave type, start date, and end date.

accepted.statement: The request form shall serve as the primary entry point into the leave lifecycle.
quotes: The request form is the primary entry point into the leave lifecycle

accepted.statement: The system shall provide a simple, guided leave request experience so that employees do not need to know company leave policy details in advance.
quotes: Employees need a simple, guided way to ask for time off without having to know the details of company leave policy up front.

accepted.statement: The system shall determine employee eligibility for leave types prior to presenting the request form.
quotes: typically presenting only the leave types for which the employee is eligible

accepted.statement: Each submitted leave request shall be routed to the employee's direct manager for approval.
quotes: The system shall route each submitted leave request to the employee's direct manager for approval.

accepted.statement: Each leave request shall have a single, clear point of accountability so that no request is lost.
quotes: Every request needs a clear, single point of accountability so that no request is lost in a shared inbox.

accepted.statement: The system shall provide managers with a dedicated queue displaying their pending leave requests.
quotes: Managers will see pending requests in a dedicated queue

accepted.statement: The pending requests queue shall order requests so that those with the earliest leave start dates appear first (i.e., are easiest to act on first).
quotes: ordered so that the earliest start dates are easiest to act on first

accepted.statement: Leave requests shall not be routed to a shared inbox.
quotes: Every request needs a clear, single point of accountability so that no request is lost in a shared inbox.

accepted.statement: The system shall prevent an employee from requesting more leave days than their available balance for the selected leave type.
quotes: An employee may not request more leave days than their available balance for the selected leave type.

accepted.statement: The system shall track leave balances per leave category rather than as a single pooled figure.
quotes: Balances are tracked per leave category rather than as a single pooled figure.

accepted.statement: The system shall maintain a separate balance for casual leave for each employee.
quotes: Each employee has a separate balance for casual, sick, and earned leave.

accepted.statement: The system shall maintain a separate balance for sick leave for each employee.
quotes: Each employee has a separate balance for casual, sick, and earned leave.

accepted.statement: The system shall maintain a separate balance for earned leave for each employee.
quotes: Each employee has a separate balance for casual, sick, and earned leave.

accepted.statement: Preventing employees from over-drawing their leave entitlements is a core goal of this release.
quotes: preventing employees from over-drawing their entitlements is one of the core goals of this release.

accepted.statement: When a leave request is approved, the system shall deduct the leave days from the employee's balance.
quotes: When a leave request is approved, the system shall deduct the leave days from the employee's balance.

accepted.statement: The deduction of leave days shall occur only after final approval, not on submission of the leave request.
quotes: The deduction shall occur only after final approval, not on submission.

accepted.statement: The system shall not deduct leave days from an employee's balance when a leave request is submitted but not yet approved.
quotes: The deduction shall occur only after final approval, not on submission.
Employees have raised concerns in the past about days being counted against them before a request is even reviewed

accepted.statement: Leave requests must be submitted at least 3 working days before the start date of the leave.
quotes: Leave requests must be submitted at least 3 working days before the start date

accepted.statement: The 3 working day advance submission requirement does not apply to sick leave.
quotes: Leave requests must be submitted at least 3 working days before the start date, except for sick leave

accepted.statement: The notice period requirement must accommodate genuine emergencies such as illness without penalizing employees.
quotes: Adequate notice helps teams plan around absences while still accommodating genuine emergencies such as illness
without penalizing employees who fall ill unexpectedly

accepted.statement: The advance notice requirement must provide managers with reasonable planning time for anticipated absences.
quotes: The intent is to give managers reasonable planning time
Adequate notice helps teams plan around absences
